verses.sanskrit:
जनमेजय उवाच।
              भगवञ्छ्रोतुमिच्छामि पुरोर्वंशकरान्नृपान्। यद्वीर्यान्यादृशांश्चापि यावतो यत्पराक्रमान्॥१॥
verses.english: Janamejaya said : Adorable Sir, I desire to hear the history of those kings who were descended from Puru. Tell me what powers and what achievements each possessed?

verses.sanskrit: न ह्यस्मिन्शीलहीनो वा निर्वीर्यो वा नराधिपः। प्रजाविरहितो वाऽपि भूतपूर्वः कथंचन॥२॥
verses.english: I have heard that in the dynasty of Puru there was not a single king who was deficient in good behaviour or in prowess. There was none who has no sons.

verses.sanskrit: तेषां प्रथितवृत्तानां राज्ञां विज्ञानशालिनाम्। चरितं श्रोतुमिच्छमि विस्तरेण तपोधन॥३॥
verses.english: O great ascetic, I desire to hear in detail the account of these kings who were endued with great learning and who possessed all accomplishments.

verses.sanskrit:
वैशंपायन उवाच।
              हन्त ते कथयिष्यामि यन्मां त्वं परिपृच्छसि। पुरोर्वंशधरान्वीराञ्च्छक्रप्रतिमतेजसः। भूरिद्रविणविक्रान्तान्सर्वलक्षणपूजितान्॥४॥
verses.english: Vaishampayana said: As you ask me I shall tell you all about the heroic kings of Puru's royal dynasty, who were all equal to Indra in power. They possessed great affluence and commanded the respect of all, on account of their many accomplishments.

verses.sanskrit: प्रवीरेश्वररौद्राश्वास्त्रयः पुत्रा महारथाः। पूरोः पौष्ट्यामजायन्त प्रवीरो वंशकृत्ततः॥५॥
verses.english: Puru begot on his wife Paushti three great car-warriors, namely Pravira, Ishvara and Raudrashva. Amongst these three, Pravira kept up the line.

verses.sanskrit: मनस्युरभवत्तस्माच्छूरसेनीसुतः प्रभुः। पृथिव्याश्चतुरन्ताया गोप्ता राजीवलोचनः॥६॥
verses.english: Pravira begot on his wife Shuraseni, a son named Manasyu. This lotus-eyed king had his sovereignty over the whole earth bounded by the four seas.

verses.sanskrit: शक्तः संहननो वाग्मी सौवीरीतनयास्त्रयः। मनस्योरभवन्पुत्राः शूराः सर्वे महारथाः॥७॥
verses.english: Manasyu begot on his wife Sauviri three sons, namely Shakta, Sanhanana and Vagmi; they were all great heroes and car-warriors.

verses.sanskrit: अन्वग्भानुप्रभृतयो मिश्रकेश्यां मनस्विनः। रौद्राश्वस्य महेष्वासा दशाप्सरसि सूनवः॥८॥
verses.english: The wise and virtuous Raudrashva begoi on Apsara Mishrakeshi ten sons who were all great bow-men. They were great heroes and performed many sacrifices in honour of the celestial; they were learned in all the Shastras and were virtuous. All of them begot sons.

verses.sanskrit: यज्वानो जज्ञिरे शूराः प्रजावन्तो बहुश्रुताः। सर्वे सर्वास्त्रविद्वासः सर्वे धर्मपरायणाः॥९॥
ऋचेयुरथ कक्षेयुः कृकणेयुश्च वीर्यवान्। स्थण्डिलेयुर्वनेयुश्च जलेयुश्च महायशाः॥१०॥
verses.english: They were Richeyu, Kaksheyu, powerful Krikaneyu, Sthandileyu, Vaneyu, greatly famous Jaleyu, intelligent and strong Tejeyu, Indra-like powerful Satyeyu, Dharmeyu and celestial-like powerful Sannateyu.

verses.sanskrit: तेजेयुर्बलावान्धीमान्सत्येयुश्चेन्द्रविक्रमः। धर्मेयुः सन्नतेयुश्च दशमो देवविक्रमः॥११॥
अनाधृष्टिरभूत्तेषां विद्वान्भुवि तथैकराट्। ऋचेयुरथ विक्रान्तो देवानामिव वासवः॥१२॥
verses.english: Amongst them all, Richeyu became the sole lord of the whole earth and was known by the name of Anadhrishti. He was in prowess like Indra.

verses.sanskrit: अनाधृष्टिसुतस्त्वासीद्राजसूयाश्वमेधकृत्। मतिनार इति ख्यातो राजा परमधार्मिकः॥१३॥
verses.english: Anadhrishti had a son, named Matinara who became a very virtuous king and greatly famous. He performed both Rajasuya and Ashvamedha sacrifices.

verses.sanskrit: मतिनारसुता राजंश्चत्वारोऽमितविक्रमाः। तंसुर्महानतिरथो द्रुह्युश्चाप्रतिमद्युतिः॥१४॥
verses.english: Matinara had four greatly powerful sons, namely Tansu, Mahan, Atiratha and immeasurably glorious Druhyu.

verses.sanskrit: तेषां तंसुर्महावीर्यः पौरवं वंशमुद्वहन्। आजहार यशो दीप्तं जिगाय च वसुंधराम्॥१५॥
verses.english: Amongst them, greatly powerful Tansu became the perpetuator of Puru's line. He subjugated the whole earth and gained great fame and splendour.

verses.sanskrit: ईलिनं तु सुतं तंसुर्जनयामास वीर्यवान्। सोऽपि कृत्स्नामिमां भूमिं विजिग्ये जयतां वरः॥१६॥
verses.english: Tansu begot a greatly powerful son, named Ilina. He also became the foremost of all conquerors and subjugated the whole world.

verses.sanskrit: रथन्तर्यां सुतान्पञ्च पञ्चभूतोपमांस्ततः। ईलिनो जनयामास दुष्यन्तप्रभृतीन्नृपान्॥१७॥
verses.english: Ilina begot on his wife, Rathantari, five sons, Dushyanta being the eldest. They were all as great in power as the five elements.

verses.sanskrit: दुष्यन्तं शूरभीमौ च प्रवसुं वसुमेव च। तेषां श्रेष्ठोऽभवद्राजा दुष्यन्तो जनमेजय॥१८॥
verses.english: (They were) Dushyanta, Shura, Bhima, Pravasu and Vasu. O Janamejaya, amongst them the eldest Dushyanta became king.

verses.sanskrit: दुष्यन्ताद्भरतो जज्ञे विद्वान्शाकुन्तलो नृपः। तस्माद्भरतवंशस्य विप्रतस्थे महद्यशः॥१९॥
verses.english: Dushyanta begot on his wife, Shakuntala, a learned son, named Bharata who became king. From him was the Bharata dynasty and from his spread its great fame.

verses.sanskrit: भरतस्तिसृषु स्त्रीषु नव पुत्रानजीजनत् । नाभ्यनन्दत तान्राजा नानुरूपा ममेत्युत ॥२०॥
verses.english: Bharata begot on his three wives nine sons, but none of them was like his father and Bharata was not satisfied with any of them.

verses.sanskrit: ततस्तान्मातरः कुद्धाः पुत्रान्निन्युर्यमक्षयम् । ततस्तस्य नरेन्द्रस्य वितथं पुत्रजन्म तत् ॥२१॥
verses.english: Thereupon their mothers, becoming angry, killed them all. Therefore, the procreation of that great king was in vain.

verses.sanskrit: ततो महद्भिः क्रतुभिरीजानो भरतस्तदा । लेभे पुत्रं भरद्वाजाद्भुमन्युं नाम भारत ॥२२॥
verses.english: The king then performed a great sacrifice and obtained a son, named Bhumanyu through the grace of Bharadvaja.
verses.bhavadeepa: वितथं विगतस्तथा भावो जनकसादृश्यं यत्र तत्तादृशं पुत्रजन्म ॥२१॥

verses.sanskrit: ततः पुत्रिणमात्मानं ज्ञात्वा पौरवनन्दनः । भुमन्युं भरतश्रेष्ठ यौवराज्येऽभ्यषेचयत् ॥२३॥
verses.english: O best of the Bharata race, the descendant of Puru, regarding himself as really possessing a son, installed him as his heir-apparent.

verses.sanskrit: ततो दिविरथो नाम भुमन्योरभवत्सुतः। सुहोत्रश्च सुहोता च सुहविः सुयजुस्तथा ॥२४॥
verses.english: Bhumanyu begot on his wife Pushkarini six sons, namely Suhotra, Suhota Suhavi, Suyaju, Richika and Diviratha. The eldest of them Suhotra obtained the throne of the world.

verses.sanskrit: पुष्करिण्यामृचीकश्च भुमन्योरभयन्सुताः। तेषां ज्येष्ठः सुहोत्रस्तु राज्यमाप महीक्षिताम्॥२५॥
राजसूयाश्वमेधाद्यैः सोयजद्बहुभिः सवैः। सृहोत्रः पृथिवीं कृत्स्नां बुभुजे सागराम्बराम्॥२६॥
verses.english: He performed many Rajasuya and Horsesacrifices. He subjugated the whole earth bounded by the four seas, And full of elephants, kine, horses and great wealth of gems and gold. The earth was, as it were, sinking with the weight of numberless human beings, elephants, horses and cars. Suhotra virtuously ruled over all his subjects.

verses.sanskrit: पूर्णां हस्तिगजाश्वैश्च बहुरक्षसमाकुलाम्। ममजेव मही तस्य भूरिभारावपीडिता ॥२७॥
हस्त्यश्वरथसंपूर्णा मनुष्यकलिला भृशम्। सुहोत्रे राजनि तदा धर्मतः शासति प्रजाः ॥२८॥
चैत्ययूपाङ्किता चासीद्भूमिः शतसहस्रशः। प्रवृद्धजनसस्या च सर्वदैव व्यरोचत ॥२९॥
verses.english: During his reign, the surface of the whole earth was dotted all over with hundreds and thousands of sacrificial stakes. The earth became full of corns and human beings.

verses.sanskrit: पेक्ष्वाकी जनयामास सुहोत्रात्पृथिवीपतेः। अजमीढं सुमीढं च पुरुमीढं च भारत ॥३०॥
verses.english: O descendent of the Bharata race, the lord of the earth Suhotra begot on his wife, Aikshvaki three sons, namely Ajamidha, Sumidha and Purumidha.

verses.sanskrit: अजमीढो वरस्तेषां तस्मिन्वंशः प्रतिष्ठितः। षट्‌पुत्रान्सोप्यजनयत्तिसृषु स्त्रीषु भारत॥३१॥
verses.english: The eldest of them Ajamidha became the perpetuator of the royal line. O descendant of the Bharata race, he begot six sons upon his three wives.

verses.sanskrit: ऋक्षं धूमिन्यथो नीली दुष्यन्तपरमेष्ठिनौ। केशिन्यजनयज्जह्नुं सुतौ व्रजनरूपिणौ॥३२॥
verses.english: Riksha was born in the womb of Dhumini, Dushyanta and Parameshti in that of Nili and Jahnu, Jala and Rupina in that of Keshini.

verses.sanskrit: तथेमे सर्वपञ्चाला दुष्यन्तपरमेष्ठिनोः। अन्वयाः कुशिका राजञ्जह्नोरमिततेजसः॥३३॥
verses.english: All the Panchalas were descended from Dushyanta and Parameshti. The Kushikas were the descendants of the greatly effulgent Jahnu.

verses.sanskrit: व्रजनरूपिणयोर्ज्येष्ठमृक्षमाहुर्जनाधिपम्। ऋक्षात्संवरणो जज्ञे राजन्वंशकरः सुतः॥३४॥
verses.english: Riksha was elder than Jala and Rupina; he begot Samvarana, who was the perpetuator of the line.

verses.sanskrit: आर्क्षे संवरणे राजन्प्रशासति वसुंधराम् । संक्षयः सुमहानासीत्प्रजानामिति नः श्रुतम् ॥३५॥
verses.english: O king, it has been heard by us that when Samvarana, the son of Riksha, was ruling the earth, there occurred a great loss of people on account of famine, plague, draught and disease.

verses.sanskrit: व्यशीर्यत ततो राष्ट्रं क्षयैर्नानाविधैस्तदा । क्षुन्मृत्युभ्यामनावृष्ट्या व्याधिभिश्च समाहतम् ॥३६॥
अभ्यघ्नन्‌ भारतांश्चैव सपत्नानां बलानि च । चालयन्वसुधां चेमां बलेन चतुरङ्गिणा ॥३७॥
verses.english: The Bharata princes were defeated by the armies of their enemies; and the Panchalas, set out with their four kinds of troops to conquer the earth. They soon brought the whole earth under their sway and with their ten Akshauhinis of soldiers the king of the Panchalas defeated the princes of Bharata.

verses.sanskrit: अभ्ययाप्तं च पाञ्चाल्यो विजित्य तरसा महीम्। अक्षौहिणीभिर्दशभिः स एनं समरेऽजयत् ॥३८॥
ततः सदारः सामात्यः सपुत्रः ससुहृज्जनः। राजा संवरणस्तस्मात्पलायत महाभयात्॥३९॥
verses.english: Samvarana then fled in fear with his wife, sons, relatives and ministers from that place.
verses.bhavadeepa: क्षयैः नाशेहतुभिः क्षुत्प्रभृतिभिः अभ्ययात्तं संवरणम् एनं संवरणमेव ॥३८॥

verses.sanskrit: सिन्धोर्नदस्य महतो निकुञ्जे न्यघसत्तदा। नदीविषयपर्यन्ते पर्वतस्य समीपतः ॥४०॥
verses.english: He took shelter in the forest on the banks of the river Sindhu which extended up to the foot of the mountain.

verses.sanskrit: तत्रावसन्बहून्कालान्भारता दुर्गमाश्रिताः। तेषां निवसतां तत्र सहस्रं परिवत्सरान्॥४१॥
verses.english: There lived the Bharatas within their fort for many years; and thus full one thousand years: and thus full one thousand years passed away.

verses.sanskrit: अथाभ्यगच्छद्भरतान्वसिष्ठो भगवानृषिः । तमागतं प्रयत्नेन प्रत्युद्गम्याभिवाद्य च ॥४२॥
verses.english: (And when they were living there), the illustrious Rishi Vasistha one day came to those exiled Bharatas. On his approach, they went out and duly worshipped him. All the Bharatas offered him Arghya and entertaining him with reverence, they told every thing to the great Rishi. When he was seated on his seat, the king himself addressed him thus, "O illustrious man, be our priest. We shall try to regain our kingdom."

verses.sanskrit: अर्घ्यमन्याहरंस्तस्मै ते सर्वे भारतास्तदा। निवेद्य सर्वमृषये सत्कारेण सुवचसे॥४३॥
तमासने चोपविष्टं राजा वव्रे स्वयं तदा। पुरोहितो भवान्नोऽस्तु राजाय प्रयतेमहि ॥४४॥
ओमित्येवं वसिष्ठोऽपि भारतान्प्रत्यपद्यत। अथाभ्यषिञ्चत्साम्राज्ये सर्वक्षत्रस्य पौरवम् ॥४५॥
verses.english: Vasistha replied to the Bharatas by saying Om. We have heard that Vasistha installed the best of the Pauravas (Samvarana) as the lord over all the Kshatriya races. The king retook the capital that was lost.

verses.sanskrit: विषाणभूतं सर्वस्यां पृथिव्यामिति नः श्रुतम् । भरताध्युषितं पूर्वं सोऽध्यतिष्ठत्पुरोत्तमम् ॥४६॥
पुनर्बलिभृतश्चैव चक्रे सर्वमहीक्षितः । ततः स पृथिवीं प्राप्य पुनरीजे महाबलः ॥४७॥
verses.english: He then began to make all the other kings of the world to pay tribute to him. That powerful monarch, thus getting possession of the whole earth, performed many sacrifices in which great presents were made to the Brahmanas. Samvarana begot on his wife Tapati, the daughter of Surya, a son named Kuru.

verses.sanskrit: आजमीढो महायज्ञैर्बहुभिर्भूरिदक्षिणैः । ततः संवरणात्सौरी तपती सुषुवे कुरुम् ॥४८॥
राजत्वे तं प्रजाः सर्वा धर्मज्ञ इति वव्रिरे । तस्य नाम्नाऽभिविख्यातं पृथिव्यां कुरुजाङ्गलम् ॥४९॥
verses.english: As Kuru was greatly virtuous, he was installed as the king by all the people. It is after his name that Kuru Jangala has become so famous in the world.

verses.sanskrit: कुरुक्षेत्रं स तपसा पुण्यं चक्रे महातपाः । अश्ववन्तमभिष्यन्तं तथा चैत्ररथं मुनिम् ॥५०॥
verses.english: That great ascetic made Kurukshetra famous by his asceticism there. We have heard that Avikshit, Abhishyanta, Chaitraratha, Muni and famous Janamejaya were the five sons begot by him on his highly intelligent wife Vahini.

verses.sanskrit: जनमेजयं च विख्यातं पुत्रांश्चास्यानुशुश्रुमः । पञ्चैतान्वाहिनीपुत्रान्व्यजायत मनस्विनी ॥५१॥
अविक्षितः परिक्षित्तु शबलाश्वस्तु वीर्यवान्। आदिराजो विराजश्च शाल्मलिश्च महाबलः॥५२॥
verses.english: Avikshit begot Parikshit, powerful Sabalashva, Adiraja, Viraja, greatly strong Shalmali, Uchchaishrava, Bhangakara and the eighth Jitari. In the race of these (eight heroes) were born, as the fruits of their many virtuous acts, seven greatly powerful car-warriors, Janamejaya being at the head.

verses.sanskrit: उच्चैःश्रवा भङ्गकारो जितारिश्चाष्टमः स्मृतः । एतेषामन्ववाये तु ख्यातास्ते कर्मजैर्गुणैः । जनमेजयादयः सप्त तथैवान्ये महारथाः ॥५३॥
परीक्षितोऽभवन्पुत्राः सर्वे धर्मार्थकोविदाः। कक्षसेनोऽग्रसेनौ तु चित्रसेनश्च वीर्यवान् ॥५४॥
verses.english: Parikshit had sons who were all learned Dharma and Artha. They were Kakshasena, Ugrasena and greatly effulgent Chitrasena, Indrasena, Sushena and Bhimasena. All the sons of Janamejaya were famous in the world as being greatly powerful (princes). They were Dhritarashtra, the eldest, Pandu, Balhika, greatly effulgent Nishada, the mighty Jambunada, Kundodara, Padati and the eighth Vasati. They were all learned in Dharma and Artha and engaged in doing good to all creatures.

verses.sanskrit: इन्द्रसेनः सुषेणश्च भीमसेनश्च नामतः। जनमेजयस्य तनया भुवि ख्याता महाबलाः॥५५॥
धृतराष्ट्रः प्रथमजः पाण्डुर्बाह्लीक एव च । निषधश्च महातेजास्तथा जाम्बूनदो बली॥५६॥
कुण्डोदरः पदातिश्च वसातिश्चाष्टमः स्मृतः । सर्वे धर्मार्थकुशलाः सर्वभूतहिते रताः ॥५७॥
धृतराष्ट्रोऽथ राजासीत्तस्य पुत्रोऽथ कुण्डिकः। हस्ती वितर्कः क्राथश्च कुण्डिनश्चापिः पञ्चमः॥५८॥
verses.english: Amongst them Dhritarashtra became king and he had eight sons, namely Kundika, Hasti, Vitarka, Kratha, Kundina, Havishrava, Indrabha and the invincible Bhumanyu. Amongst the sons of Dhritarashtra only three were famous. O descendant of Bharata, (they were) Pratipa, Dharmanetra and Sunetra. Amongst the three Pratipa became unrivalled of all.

verses.sanskrit: हविः श्रवास्तथेन्द्राभो भुमन्युश्चापराजितः । धृतराष्ट्रसुतानां तु त्रीनेतान्प्रथितान्भुवि ॥५९॥
प्रतीपं धर्मनेत्रं च सुनेत्रं चापि भारत । प्रतीपः प्रथितस्तेषां बभूवाप्रतिमो भुवि॥६०॥
verses.bhavadeepa: सुतानां कुण्डिकादीनां मध्ये प्रथितान् आहुरिति शेषः । दिवशित्वम् । वीर्यं शारीरं बलम् । ओजः मानसं सामर्थ्यं प्रथितानाहुरिति व्याख्येयम् ॥५९॥

verses.sanskrit: प्रतीपस्य त्रयः पुत्रा जज्ञिरे भरतर्षभ। देवापिः शान्तनुश्चैव बाह्लीकश्च महारथः ॥६१॥
verses.english: O best of the Bharata race, Pratipa begot three sons, namely Devapi, Shantanu and mighty car-warrior Balhika. Devapi adopted asceticism, impelled by the desire to do good to his brothers. Consequently the kingdom was obtained by Shantanu and the mighty carwarrior Balhika.

verses.sanskrit: देवापिश्च प्रवव्राज तेषां धर्महितेप्सया। शान्तनुश्च महीं लेभे बाह्रीकञ्च महारथः॥६२॥
भरतस्यान्वये जाताः सत्ववन्तो नराधिपाः। देवर्षिकल्पा नृपते बहवो राजसत्तमाः ॥६३॥
verses.english: O king, besides these (I have mentioned), there were born in the Bharata race many other good monarchs all greatly effulgent and all like the celestial Rishis in virtue and ascetic power.

verses.sanskrit: एवंविधाश्चाप्यपरे देवकल्पा महारथाः। जाता मनोरन्ववाये ऐलवंशविवर्धनाः ॥६४॥
verses.english: In this way were born in the race of Manu, many mighty car-warriors like the celestials themselves and who by their number greatly increased the Aila dynasty.
